features: Important — The budget overrun amount was understated by the VAT. When you record an invoice that exceeds a budget line's remaining balance, the overrun dialog shows the "Total excess": that figure counted only the net amount of the invoice being entered, while the line's remaining balance was already calculated on the gross amount (net plus VAT) of previously recorded invoices. Two different quantities were therefore being compared, and the excess shown came out lower than the real one by exactly the VAT of the invoice you were entering. The gap accumulated as more invoices were recorded against the same budget line. In some cases the dialog did not appear at all and the invoice was recorded over budget without asking anything. Reported by a user on the forum.

Important — The same error had accounting consequences, not just display ones. When "Reserve fund" was chosen as the recovery strategy, the amount shown was used as-is for the covering entry: the transfer from the fund covered less than it should, and the difference equalled the invoice's VAT. If you have recorded overruns covered by a reserve fund, it is worth checking the amount: the coverage may be lower than the actual overrun.

Important — When editing an invoice, the overrun justification was not saved. Editing an invoice until it exceeded the budget line opened the dialog asking for a justification, a recovery strategy and a fund to use: none of what you filled in was recorded, however — neither the justification, nor the coverage, nor the invoice moving to the "overrun justified" state. The dialog has been replaced by a notice that stays on screen and explains the situation: an overrun cannot be justified while editing, and doing so requires reversing the invoice and recording it again. Saving an edit continues to work as before.

Removed the "Off budget" button from the invoice edit page, which marked a line as an unforeseen expense. Unforeseen expenses are not accepted when editing: saving was rejected without showing any message and the page simply stayed put, with no explanation. Here too the correct route is a reversal followed by a new entry.

The red "Budget overrun" marker shown under a line's amount now accounts for VAT, like the budget analysis panel beside it. Previously it could stay off on a line the panel was already flagging as over budget.
This update does not change the database structure: no migration to run.
